Market today: Retail sales are strong, showing economic momentum, but a sovereign wealth fund warns of a pullback. This mixed signal means tech/chip names, which move fast on margin, need careful watching.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.8%) and SPAL (-37.89%) are still deep in the red and flagged for attention. SMH (-14.81%) and QQQI (-4.47%) are also marked for trim. CRWD (34.81%) is your lone winner.

Watch: The Intel/SK Hynix report on memory chip manufacturing could impact SMH and other chip names.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any news impacting the chip sector.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming further if it doesn't show immediate strength, given its leveraged nature and current losses.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming this leveraged ETF if weakness persists.
No new buys today - hold and watch
